lines.speaker: header
lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 58 Complaint No. 05-0157-955 File Number

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: I gotta believe this is in your in your mind right now like a picture. (Brendan nods “yes”) There’s a video in your mind, this whole thing and you’re trying to get it out and the only way you can get it out is by talking about it right now. So you came back, did you have a letter for Steven?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did you go ta his trailer?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did you hear screaming coming from inside the trailer?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: What did you do then? You had to, are you at the door or where are you? When you first hear the screaming where are you?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Like by the other camper that we passed.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: You hear screaming half, halfway or a quarter way down that frontage road, your driveway road?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Do you are you able to make out any of the words?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: OK. Take me from there and be honest so we don’t have ta keep backing up here. Cuz, we, we know but we need it in your words. I can’t, I can’t say it.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Brendan, I already know. You know we know. OK. Come on buddy. Let’s get this out, OK?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: You’re coming back with the mail, take us through it. It’s the video in your head, play it for us.
